result.summary: WF-02 step 1 for REQ-108 (R1.1) and REQ-109 (R1.4): the design docs/design/REQ-108-109-app-skeleton.md (about 121 KB, sections 0-22). It settles the file tree of app/ (every file's role, exports, signatures, config keys with error codes and messages, the plain lines of the entries), the pins (hono 4.13.16, @hono/node-server 2.1.6, pg 8.23.1; dev @electric-sql/pglite 0.5.15, typescript 6.0.3, @types/node 22.20.5, @types/pg 8.23.1 and the four lint/format versions of tools/; the lockfile made with npm install --before, 101 entries all at least 14 days old and from npmjs), the one check command of app/, the database (PGlite supports CREATE ROLE, forced RLS under SET LOCAL ROLE and advisory locks; its session user is a superuser, so the PGlite adapter switches to sai_app_login by SET SESSION AUTHORIZATION after the migrations and the one selfcheck statement reads session_user on both; the password form of decisions/0116 О24 works on PGlite, Postgres 16.14 and Postgres 17.12 with a guarded DO block — without the handler the error carries the password; the password step is a runner step on every run), the Vercel shape and nine facts that wait for spikes S1-S3, app.yml (check, pg, docker; green on GitHub), Docker and compose parity, the Low points N1-N6 and N8, the criterion -> test table for all 25 criteria, a catalogue of 79 named tests in 26 files, the replacement table (no guard test turns red, measured by check.yml on GitHub), 11 build sub-steps (B1-B7 BACKEND-DEV, T1-T4 TEST-DESIGNER), 48 mutants (29 applied on the sketch), the bar section Q1-Q14, R1-R3, failure paths, the time budget, and 17 open questions with defaults. Three points of the requirement need ORCH before gate 1b: criterion 14 of REQ-108 cannot be met as written (Chrome logs one console error for every 404 or 503 page, О2), the pg job cannot use a services: container with a password made in the run (О4), and a test step with no test file passes criterion 2's counts (О17). Every statement was measured on a sketch outside the project; one temporary branch ci/m1code-design-1 was pushed, its two runs read (app.yml success, check.yml success 2209/2209) and the branch deleted. No Vercel command, no deploy, no commit to the project.

issues.text: context.agent_run_id: I cannot see the id of my launch in this session; it stays null (ORCH's field, not written by me).

REQ-108 criterion 14 cannot be met as written: Chrome writes one console error «Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)» for /nope and «… 503 (Service Unavailable)» for the gate page in every load (F16, measured 6 of 6 each), while criteria 5 and 9 require those statuses and criterion 14 excuses no console line. Proposal: a micro-amendment of REQ-108 before gate 1b (design О2).

Outside this run: npm ci on the GitHub runner reports «3 moderate severity vulnerabilities» for the whole tree in tools/ (and in app/, the same dev packages); npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high is clean in app/. For ORCH to decide whether a defect is opened for tools/ (quality-bar §6 item 6).

О1 — the browser-test tool of app/ (decisions/0116 О3). Default: playwright-core (exact version, ≥ 14 days old), from node:test, channel chrome, a fresh context per test, --use-mock-keychain, a URL guard for the test's own 127.0.0.1 and localhost hosts; installed with the first browser test (R1.2), not now. Proposal for a decisions/ record (design section 8).

О2 — criterion 14 (I2). Default: a micro-amendment excusing exactly one console line per load on /nope and on the gate page: level error, that text with that status, the URL of the page itself; any other line fails.
О3 — the scope of tsc. Default: api/, server/, scripts/, public/ and eslint.config.js; not test/.

О4 — the Postgres of the pg job. Default: docker run in a step with a password made and masked in the run, read as the «postgres:17@sha256:… service» of criterion 11 (a services: container starts before any step; trust auth would make the login check prove nothing). Alternative: services: with a predictable password expression.

О5 — stricter rules than criterion 3 lists (N2 plus node:worker_threads, node:vm, eval(, Function(, the names globalThis, global, self, window, the member getBuiltinModule, a destructuring of the node:http binding). Default: all red.
О6 — /api/health values when the database is down. Default: role "unknown", migrations_pending null.
О7 — the error codes not_found, bad_request, body_too_large, bad_encoding, site_closed, server_error, server_config (design 4.2). Default: as written.
О8 — the test-only variables PGLITE_DIR and MIGRATIONS_DIR. Default: these names, refused with NODE_ENV=production, listed in app/.env.example.
О9 — the closed vercel-build refuses to replace public/ inside a git working tree; S1 builds once with SITE_GATE=closed on a protected preview deployment. Default: as written.
О10 — /gate.html is reachable while the site is open (Node, Docker, Vercel). Default: accepted.
О11 — a Postgres server with log_statement all logs bound values, the password of the password step included (F10). Default: a named limit in the design and app/README.md; S3 reads Neon's logging.
О12 — no CSS file and no icon file in M1. Default: none (browser colours pass 4.5:1; the icon is data:,).
О13 — three helper files under app/test/fixtures/ (helpers.js, db.js, pg-env.js), beyond the test files named in the criteria. Default: allowed (ARCH §2 lists test/fixtures/).
О14 — app/server/db/tx.js holds only withPlatform with a one-statement body in M1; the adapter's transaction method comes with M2. Default: as written.
О15 — the Addition to decisions/0001: the dev type packages @types/node and @types/pg (MIT), the transitive BlueOak-1.0.0 of minimatch named, no install-script exception. Default: ORCH appends it.
О16 — the post-deploy smoke of REQ-109 runs without --preview (no second host before S2). Default: --preview stays optional.

О17 — node --test over a glob that matches nothing ends with 0 and «# tests 0» (F28), so criterion 2's counts are met by an empty folder. Default: the presence guards NPM-5 and NM-5 and the reading of «# tests» by TEST-RUNNER and RELEASE-VALIDATOR; a micro-amendment adding «# tests ≥ 1» is ORCH's choice.

My first mutant series (6 min 5 s) left three sketch servers of node-main running in the mutant clone after the harness ended a hung test process at its 120 s limit (a mutant of the unsafe-role exit among them; AP-140 kind). Found after the series by their working folder, stopped by their pids (ps shows none left); the design now asks a per-test timeout, the kill in t.after and a kill by recorded pids (section 16). For DOC-UPDATER: a candidate for the error journal together with F19 (bash -e and a negated pipeline), F27 (the cancel of one branch of a tee waits for the other) and F16 (the console line of a 404 page, the kind of AP-117).

Safety record: every sketch server listened on 127.0.0.1 port 0; the private Postgres listened on no TCP port at all (a Unix socket in the work folder) and was stopped at the end; the Chrome runs used the kit's withBrowser with TMPDIR set to the work folder (fresh profiles there); ports 4780/4781/4782/4790 were never touched; Pixel Office, the team server and the real claude were not started; SAI_TEAM_REAL_RUNS was never set; no Vercel command and no Vercel login; no commit in the project; no permission check denied a command. One zsh slip: a node -e script with a quote in its text failed to parse (nothing ran); the edits went through files in the work folder after it.
